poses.caption: Hold a straight plank with both hands on the medicine ball
Bend elbows to lower the chest toward the ball, then press up

jobs.detail: MEDICINE BALL PUSH-UP, TWO phases. Whole body front side three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT. ONE small round DARK GRAY medicine ball about30-35cm diameter on FLOOR under BOTH palms, NOT large stability ball/Bosu/bench. BOTH hands on opposite upper-sides of SAME ball, near shoulder-width as ball permits, fingers spread over sphere, wrists continuous. Feet hip width toes FLOOR behind, legs/knees STRAIGHT. LEFT high plank arms extended, body straight shoulder-hip-heels. RIGHT lower chest toward ball by bending elbows90degrees, chest above sphere not intersecting, hips stay in line. Ball size/position and hand contacts unchanged, no moving or duplicated ball. Whole person/fingers/shoes/ball inside panel white margins. Primary CHEST only soft diffuse BLURRED RED patches on intact OPAQUE BLACK shirt; NO fiber rays/anatomical pectoral divisions in fabric. All exposed arms/legs fine grayscale anatomical fibers. Fully opaque black sleeveless shirt wraps front sides back and loose knee shorts wrap front sides rear seat crotch, no transparent/cutaways. No text.

jobs.detail: PUSH-UP TO ALTERNATING SIDE PLANK, THREE phases on FLOOR MAT, whole body same side three-quarter camera head LEFT feet RIGHT, no equipment. LEFT LOW PUSH-UP both palms shoulder width mat elbows90degrees, torso straight and both toes support legs together. MIDDLE after press-up rotate onto LEFT hand/outer LEFT foot, LEFT elbow straight directly UNDER left shoulder, legs STRAIGHT feet stacked, hips elevated head-hips-feet straight sideways line. Torso/front chest faces VIEWER, RIGHT arm straight VERTICALLY UP from right shoulder, right open hand fingers extended, shoulders stacked. RIGHT after next push-up rotate OPPOSITE onto RIGHT hand/outer RIGHT foot, RIGHT elbow straight UNDER right shoulder, legs straight feet stacked, hips lifted; BACK of shirt faces VIEWER, LEFT arm straight vertically UP from left shoulder. Clearly opposite support/raised-arm roles and front/back torso change, exactly2arms2legs each, no limb intersection. Floor hand stays planted, raised hand clear overhead, all fingers/shoes fit margins. Primary ABS only soft diffuse red tint over intact opaque BLACK abdominal shirt front/side when visible; back shirt stays BLACK, no red spine/triceps/shoulders. No anatomical subdivisions/fibers/radial rays through clothes. Shirt/loose knee shorts fully opaque around torso/front/sides/back/seat/crotch. Fine grayscale exposed muscles. No text/arrows.
